title: Time Feature Extractor
text: Extract time-domain features from signals, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Window length} sets the number of samples per frame, {Specify} sets the buffering method Overlap, {Overlap length} sets the number of overlapping samples between consecutive, {Hop size} sets the number of samples between the start, {Mean} sets the option to extract mean, {RMS} sets the option to extract root mean square, {Standard deviation} sets the option to extract standard deviation, {Shape factor} sets the option to extract shape factor, {SNR} sets the option to extract signal-to-noise ratio, {THD} sets the option to extract total harmonic, {SINAD} sets the option to extract signal to noise and distortion, {Peak value} sets the option to extract peak value, {Crest factor} sets the option to extract crest factor, {Clearance factor} sets the option to extract clearance factor, {Impulse factor} sets the option to extract impulse factor and {Feature to output mapping} displays column indices of features in output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Window length
params.values: Number of samples per frame 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify
params.values: Buffering method Overlap length (default) | Hop size

params.name: Overlap length
params.values: Number of overlapping samples between consecutive frames 0 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Hop size
params.values: Number of samples between the start of frames 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Mean
params.values: Option to extract mean on (default) | off

params.name: RMS
params.values: Option to extract root mean square off (default) | on

params.name: Standard deviation
params.values: Option to extract standard deviation off (default) | on

params.name: Shape factor
params.values: Option to extract shape factor off (default) | on

params.name: SNR
params.values: Option to extract signal-to-noise ratio off (default) | on

params.name: THD
params.values: Option to extract total harmonic distortion off (default) | on

params.name: SINAD
params.values: Option to extract signal to noise and distortion ratio off (default) | on

params.name: Peak value
params.values: Option to extract peak value off (default) | on

params.name: Crest factor
params.values: Option to extract crest factor off (default) | on

params.name: Clearance factor
params.values: Option to extract clearance factor off (default) | on

params.name: Impulse factor
params.values: Option to extract impulse factor off (default) | on

params.name: Feature to output mapping
params.values: Display column indices of features in output section
